references.text: Confirms the identity of Oholibamah's sons and their status as chiefs in Edom's genealogy.
Confirms the names of Oholibamah's sons within a broader Edomite genealogy in Chronicles.
Links the mother of the chiefs (Oholibamah) to her lineage and her identity as the daughter of Anah.
Confirms Oholibamah's relationship as the daughter of Anah, which is central to understanding the background of the chiefs.
A complementary list showing that Esau also had sons from other wives, completing the picture of Edomite chiefs.
